summary_md:
# Industrijättarnas delårssiffror – över 60 bolag rapporterar i dag

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's report special covered more than 60 companies reporting on 23 October 2026, against a weak market backdrop and a sharp sector rotation away from engineering and banks. Volvo Cars was called a 'catastrophe report' and judged not investable. AB Volvo, Saab and Munters posted solid numbers, but the panel doubted they had enough 'wow factor' to lift the shares in a turbulent market. Consumer names such as BHG, Bravida and a relieved Electrolux were seen as the brighter spots.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VOLV-B — AB Volvo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Strong margins and cash flow, NA 2027 forecast raised to 300k, share gains in NA, low valuation after the fall from 371 to 311 SEK. Dividend expected at 16-17 SEK.

#### Reasoning

Both Hägerstrand and Söderfjell called it a good investment level for long-term investors. Margins expanded to 12.3%, Mack and Volvo gained market share in North America, and earnings estimates are likely to be revised up. Short term the stock may not lift because of the rotation out of engineering stocks. Carnegie holds a sell rating on China competition concerns.

#### Sell Triggers

- Chinese competition erodes BEV share further
- NA order intake weakens
- US emissions legislation causes order cancellations
- High diesel prices hurt haulier demand

> *"För den som är långsiktig så är det här ett bra investeringsläge."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Larger loss, -9bn cash flow, net cash down to ~1bn, savings program seen as insufficient, Q4 also tough.

#### Reasoning

The panel said volumes are too low and the company cannot save its way to success. China is down 20% and losing share to local makers, and its new local products only arrive mid-next year. The cash burn rate is unsustainable and the balance sheet is eroding, so the panel described the stock as not investable.

#### Sell Triggers

- Cash burn slows materially
- EX60 production ramp resolved and volumes reach ~150k in China

> *"Så för mig är det inte riktigt investeringsbart."*

---

### 🟢 BHG — BHG | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Organic growth ~9%, margin improving for a long streak, nearing its 5% target despite oil and dollar headwinds.

#### Reasoning

The podcast analyst sees the report as a strong turnaround proof point: debt is reduced and margins keep expanding. The consumer sector is preferred over heavy engineering in the current rotation.

#### Sell Triggers

- Margin improvement stalls
- Gross margin squeezed further by oil prices/USD

> *"Så jag tycker den här ska upp idag."*

---

### 🟠 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

EBIT 8% better than expected, debt reduced. Outlook tough, volume/price/mix cut to neutral.

#### Reasoning

Lasse thinks the beat could be enough for a much-needed rise given where the stock comes from. The analysts call it some stabilisation but still messy: high leverage, Chinese competition, the complex Midea JV and weak NA consumer demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- Further cut in volume/price/mix guidance
- NA consumer confidence deteriorates

> *"så tror jag att det där faktiskt kan räcka till en uppgång. En välbehövlig uppgång för Electrolux."*

---

### 🟢 BRAV — Bravida | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Orders +72% led by data centers, organic growth 9%, margin 6.7% vs 5.3%, good cash flow, buyback with share cancellation.

#### Reasoning

The analyst finds the report hard to fault and expects a bounce after the recent dip. The shareholder-friendly buyback model is praised. Order books stretch out to 2028-2029.

#### Sell Triggers

- Data center orders delayed or cancelled
- Margin reverses

> *"Jag tror den där kan studsa tillbaka lite här."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Order intake far above expectations but DCT profit below estimates; component shortages and tariffs weigh. CMD on 11 Nov.

#### Reasoning

Strong order book supports future earnings, but the beat came from AirTech and DCT missed. The market is currently not rewarding AI and data center orders, so whether the stock is rewarded depends on DCT margin recovery.

#### Sell Triggers

- Component shortages persist
- Order cancellations
- DCT margin fails to improve

> *"Men jag tror det finns en risk för att man kommer säga att det här är lite starkt på fel ställen."*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Order intake ~11% above expectations, which de-risks future estimates; results in line, no wow factor short term.

#### Reasoning

Lasse is positive: strong orders de-risk earnings forecasts. But results only met expectations, which may not lift the stock in a choppy market, and some critics view the valuation as high.

#### Sell Triggers

- Order momentum fades
- Valuation concerns intensify

> *"Det avriskar ju vinstprognoserna för framtiden."*

---
